name: Google Finance Search
description: Search Google Finance for a ticker symbol or company name, return matching quote links with ticker, company, price, and change data.

inputs.name: query
inputs.description: Ticker symbol (e.g. AAPL) or company name (e.g. Apple)

body.name: waitForSelector

args.selector: div[role=button][aria-label="Search for stocks, ETFs, and more"]

body.note: Wait for the search launcher button to appear.

body.name: click

args.selector: div[role=button][aria-label="Search for stocks, ETFs, and more"]

body.note: Click the search launcher to reveal the search textarea.

body.name: waitForSelector
body.note: Wait for the search textarea to become visible.

body.name: waitForURL
body.note: Wait for navigation to a quote-result route (must not already match the homepage).

body.name: waitForTimeout
body.note: Wait for quote page content to render after navigation.

body.name: js

args.expression:
(function(){var t=document.title||"";var u=window.location.href;var text=(document.body.innerText||"").slice(0,6000).trim();var ticker=null;var company=null;var price=null;var change=null;var um=u.match(//quote/([A-Z]+):([A-Z]+)/);if(um)ticker=um[1];var pm=text.match(/\$([\d,]+\.\d{2})
arrow_upward
\+([\d.]+)%/);if(pm){price="$"+pm[1];change="+"+pm[2]+"%";}else{var pd=text.match(/\$([\d,]+\.\d{2})
arrow_downward
-([\d.]+)%/);if(pd){price="$"+pd[1];change="-"+pd[2]+"%";}}var lines=text.split("
");for(var i=0;i<lines.length;i++){if(lines[i].trim()===price&&i>0){company=lines[i-1].trim();break;}}var results=[];var links=[];if(ticker){results.push({ticker:ticker,company:company,price:price,change:change,url:u});links.push(u);}return {count:results.length,results:results,links:links,text:text};})()

body.note: Extract the current stock quote from the page title and URL.

outputs.name: results
outputs.description: Quote results, each with ticker, company, price, change, and url.

outputs.name: text
outputs.description: Visible text from the results page (max 6000 chars).
